comparison.objective: Calibrate a colorimeter with the correctly oriented blank, measure a sample at a specified wavelength, and return both cuvettes; candidate adjusts and locks a gripper opening stop, then verifies motion.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-996 tests cuvette identification, optical-face alignment, well insertion, lid/button operation, and instrument sequencing; candidate tests coaxial driver/wrench seating, countertorque, jam-nut locking, and articulated verification.
comparison.success_condition: PR-996 requires a valid calibrated absorbance record and both released cuvettes returned to separate rack pockets; candidate requires a retained 90° stop within tolerance, three repeatable cycles, retained nuts, and tool clearance.
comparison.reason: The tested mechanisms, manipulation abilities, and observable outcomes differ meaningfully; all available rubric versions specify numeric alignment, measurement, return, loss, and dwell conditions.
